channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Rubio says war on Iran unpopular but ‘necessary’ to stop nuclear threat
item.description: US secretary of state says Iran's negotiation demands are 'outrageous and ridiculous, and really not realistic'.

item.title: Drone attack suspends production at Iraq’s Khor Mor gasfield
item.description: The strike leaves more than 70 percent of northern Iraq's Kurdish region without power.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump to talk to Xi, Putin about Tehran, ‘denuclearisation’
item.description: Trump says Iran land blockade is now in effect, as Tehran threatens to 'rain down hell' if US resumes attacks.

item.title: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes
item.description: Footage authenticated by BBC Verify shows damage to the building in the capital's central financial district.

item.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
item.description: It is claimed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were part of anti-government protests earlier this year.

item.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
item.description: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.
